title: Number of Islands - Solution
intuition: Given an m x n 2D binary grid grid which represents a map of '1's (land) and '0's (water), return the number of islands.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Use DFS or BFS. When a '1' is found, increment island count and mark all connected land cells as visited (e.g. '0').
